tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: 10:00 AM Late Start Wednesday
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: District-wide teacher professional learning morning. Morning rural bus routes pick up exactly 2 hours after standard morning schedule. No morning preschool. Breakfast service runs 9:30 AM – 9:55 AM prior to the 10:00 AM bell.

tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: PRHS Testing Window: Pre-ACT (10th) & WorkKeys (11th–12th)
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: State-mandated assessment testing window for high school students. Pre-ACT administered Wednesday, Oct 21 (Grade 10); ACT WorkKeys vocational readiness exam administered Thursday, Oct 22 (Grades 11–12).

tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: No School — Veterans Day Observance
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: All USD 449 buildings and classrooms closed in honor of Veterans Day. Community Veterans Day parade in Easton.

tier1_schedule_disruptions.title: No School — Thanksgiving Holiday Break
tier1_schedule_disruptions.description: District offices and campuses closed for Thanksgiving holiday. Classes resume regular schedule Monday, November 30 at 8:00 AM.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRES 1st Grade Autumn Field Trip: Fun Farm
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Pleasant Ridge 1st graders visit Fun Farm pumpkin patch. Signed parent permission slips, sack lunch, and mud/outdoor boots required.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRHS & PRMS Portrait Retake Day
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Portrait retakes for middle and high school students who missed orientation or need re-shoots. Return original photo packets during the 8:00 AM – 11:00 AM studio window.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRES Elementary Picture Retake Day
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Elementary photo retakes for Pre-K through 5th grade. Return original proof envelopes to homeroom teachers before 8:15 AM.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRES 'Donuts with Grown-Ups' (Grades K, 1 & 2)
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Morning family breakfast dates from 7:30 AM – 8:05 AM: Kindergarten on Monday, Nov 2; 1st Grade on Tuesday, Nov 3; 2nd Grade on Wednesday, Nov 4.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: PRES 'Donuts with Grown-Ups' (Grades PK, 3, 4 & 5)
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: Morning family breakfast dates from 7:30 AM – 8:05 AM: 3rd Grade on Thursday, Nov 5; 4th Grade on Monday, Nov 9; 5th Grade & Pre-K on Tuesday, Nov 10.

tier2_gear_deadlines_action.title: USD 449 Rural Transportation Route Changes
tier2_gear_deadlines_action.description: For student safety across rural routes, afternoon bus pass requests or pickup location changes require notice to the transportation office between 7:30 AM and 1:30 PM daily.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRHS Varsity Football vs. Maur Hill-Mount Academy (Senior Night)
tier3_marquee_gatherings.time: 6:30 PM – 9:30 PM (6:30 PM Senior Ceremony · 7:00 PM Kickoff)
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: Senior Night showcase! Senior athletes, cheerleaders, band members, and cross-country runners honored on field at 6:30 PM prior to 7:00 PM kickoff vs Maur Hill.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRHS PTO Haunted Hallways & Community Trunk-or-Treat
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: District-wide autumn tradition! Walkthrough haunted hallways and parking lot trunk-or-treat hosted by PRHS PTO from 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM. Concessions open.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRMS Girls Basketball @ Everest
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: Middle school girls basketball road clash against Everest. Tipoff at 4:30 PM; B-team and A-team games conclude by ~7:00 PM.

tier3_marquee_gatherings.title: PRES Halloween Costume Parade & Classroom Parties
tier3_marquee_gatherings.description: Annual PRES Halloween costume parade beginning at 1:30 PM followed by PTO-assisted classroom parties until 3:00 PM. Elementary families welcome to observe parade.
